conceptZh: 調皮小老鼠與大腳短手橡膠恐龍抓著彈性蛛絲網拔河，用力過猛雙雙彈飛跌坐，彈開的彩色絲條與圓環在畫面中央組合成「蜘」字，最後一隻可愛玩具蜘蛛垂降亮相。
object: elastic spiderweb rope, colorful toy blocks, and a bouncy cartoon toy spider
morph: Stretched elastic web bands and colorful toy blocks snap back from a tug-of-war release and lock together into the left 虫 radical, middle 矢 component, and right 口 square of the Traditional Chinese character 蜘.
creativeAngle: 運用拔河（TUG-OF-WAR）喜劇節奏，讓調皮小老鼠與短手橡膠恐龍拉扯彈性蛛絲繩，藉由臉紅滑步到雙雙彈飛的反作用力，將絲繩與積木塊俐落彈入畫面中央拼成「虫、矢、口」結構分明的「蜘」字，並在唸出「蜘蛛」時讓玩具蜘蛛垂降呼應語音。
promptEn:
An 8-second 3D cartoon animation on a clean, warm cream-colored tabletop studio stage with soft daylight and zero background clutter. On the left stands a tiny cheeky cartoon mouse—an original design with oversized round ears and a wide grin—gripping one end of a thick, stretchy royal-blue spiderweb rope threaded with glossy cobalt-blue toy blocks. On the right stands a chunky green rubber dinosaur with enormous feet and comically tiny arms; unable to reach with its stubby hands, it clamps the other end of the web rope in its mouth.

From 0.0 to 1.8 seconds, the cheeky mouse eyes the glowing blocks in the middle of the rope, wiggles its eyebrows, and yanks hard to the left, dragging the surprised rubber dinosaur forward across the smooth floor. From 1.8 to 3.4 seconds, a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin speaks the first syllable slowly and distinctly: "蜘 (ㄓ)". The rubber dinosaur digs its giant heels in and leans its whole rubbery body backward, pulling with all its might; both characters lean further and further back at steep angles, their feet skidding wildly and their cheeks puffing bright red as the blue web rope stretches taut like a giant rubber band.

From 3.4 to 5.0 seconds, at maximum stretch, the cheeky mouse suddenly grins and lets go of a spring-loaded knot. Twang! Both the mouse and the rubber dinosaur launch backward to the far left and right edges of the frame, landing squarely on their bottoms with cartoon squash-and-stretch bounces and dizzy, cheerful grins. Simultaneously, as the off-screen voice speaks the second syllable "蜘 (ㄓ)", the released cobalt-blue web strips and blocks snap into the center of the frame and lock cleanly into the exact Traditional Chinese character "蜘", rendered in a saturated solid cobalt blue against the light cream background, centered and filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins: the left "虫" radical, the middle "矢" component, and the right "口" box all crisp, balanced, and unmistakably legible.

From 5.0 to 8.0 seconds, the finished glyph "蜘" holds completely still and sharp in the center for a full 3 seconds. Right as the off-screen voice clearly pronounces the word "蜘蛛 (ㄓ ㄓㄨ)", a round, friendly purple wind-up toy spider with eight wiggly legs drops down on a silky thread just above the top-right corner of the glyph (without covering any strokes) and waves two front legs. Down in the lower corners away from the character, the cheeky mouse gives a proud thumbs-up and the rubber dinosaur happily wiggles its huge feet. Audio consists only of gentle cartoon boing sound effects and the exact spoken line "蜘、蜘、蜘蛛 (ㄓ、ㄓ、ㄓ ㄓㄨ)" read once with clear Taiwanese Mandarin tones and no extra text or watermarks on screen.
formatted:
【目標國字】：蜘
